name: voice_assistant
description: Device-directed commands from an on-device or cloud ASR: the utterance intent (60 assistant intents + general intents), slot spans (times, dates, durations, places, people, products) and the command-complete event that tells the app when to act.
_notes: Slots are the entity / number spans inside the utterance. Act on an utterance at its endpoint (or at discourse.assistant.command_complete). Intents use the assistant profile's per-intent thresholds (some intents are disabled there by the threshold fit); the jailbreak flag is lowered from 0.6 for recall, and the PII-leak flag is kept.
